items.prompt: Grammar Practice 3-fix: Correct the wrong part of that sentence.

Grammar Practice 4: Choose the pair whose two sentences have different meanings — (a) You don't have to drink it if you are full. = You must not drink it if you are full. (b) She is not able to count numbers in English. = She can't count numbers in English. (c) We are going to play soccer this afternoon. = We will play soccer this afternoon.
items.stem: (a) You don't have to drink it if you are full. = You must not drink it if you are full. (b) She is not able to count numbers in English. = She can't count numbers in English. (c) We are going to play soccer this afternoon. = We will play soccer this afternoon.
